$comment: company-words.json: the parts of generated company trading names in the scrapyard game (yard-design.md 7.2: first + second + ending, about 40 x 40 x 8: 'Kestrel Forge Metals'). Nothing a player types is shown. 'Group' is not an ending (spec 7.1 keeps the word for nothing) and 'Salvage' is not used (spec 2). Second pass of the names step, 2026-11-25. An engineer's check, not legal or moderation clearance.

check.script: python3 scripts/content/yard/check-words.py [--wikidata]: composes every first + second (1600), second + ending (320) and first + ending (320) and runs the same filter; with --wikidata it looks every pair up as an English Wikipedia title ('Kestrel Forge', 'Kestrelforge'; with an ending 'Kestrel Metals'). Result on 2026-11-25: 0 flags.
check.structure: first parts are birds, beasts, trees, stones and landscape words; second parts are tools and machines of the yard. A first draft used landscape seconds (Hill, Field, Grove, Brook, Gate, Point ...): 144 pairs were real places, roads, stadiums or firms (Ravenfield, Oakhill, Moorgate, Meadow Lane, Valley Forge, Western Forge), so the second list was rebuilt from trade words.
check.removedByPairs: Valley (Valley Forge, Valley Furnace), River (River Crane, River Works, River Barrow), Delta (Delta Works), Northern, Southern, Eastern, Western (Northern Rail, Southern Rail, Western Forge, Western Refining; and compass words make the commonest real firm names with any ending), Crane (Hazel Crane, a person; River Crane), Gear (Granite Gear, an outdoor brand), Rail, Harbour (Sydney Harbour Bridge in the first draft), Rowan (rude letters where parts meet), Jasper ('sperm' where Jasper meets Magnet, Mallet, Metals), the ending Industries (Crucible Industries, Raven Industries, Oak Industries: real firms) replaced by Refining
check.removedByHand: Tidal (a music-streaming brand), Polar (a sports-watch brand)
check.notChecked: a real firm with no Wikipedia page ('Summit Metals', 'Granite Resources' and the like may exist somewhere): an ending pair is a generic trade description and the game shows it beside an emblem, never as a real company; the Wikipedia lookup catches the famous ones only
